# Vendored IEEEtran files

Files `IEEEtran.cls` and `IEEEtran.bst` were extracted from the CTAN
`IEEEtran.zip` distribution downloaded on 2026-09-15:

`https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/IEEEtran.zip`

The downloaded archive SHA-256 was
`e0cd4f5afbd42c8076092280e72b3e0a5111efe501d35de9f715cfb8da313cb4`.
The extracted class and bibliography-style SHA-256 values are recorded in the
snapshot manifest. The upstream README is preserved as `UPSTREAM_README`.

IEEEtran is distributed under the LaTeX Project Public License, version 1.3.
These files are unmodified and are bundled to make the snapshot buildable on
systems whose TeX installation does not include IEEEtran.
